required_facts.claim: The second cohort of my AI Engineering course finished a few weeks ago, and in this post I want to share with you what we built.
required_facts.source_evidence: The second cohort of my AI Engineering course finished a few weeks ago, and in this post I want to share with you what we built.

required_facts.claim: The projects are real-life and include personal assistants, professional tooling, and health-case assistants.
required_facts.source_evidence: The projects are real-life and include personal assistants, professional tooling, and health-case assistants.

required_facts.claim: Some of us presented the projects live a few weeks ago on the demo day, so we’ll start with them.

required_facts.claim: 1) bAIpacking Agent by Eduardo Gonzalo Almorox Edu’s [bAIpacking Agent] helps long‑distance cyclists decide which tires, drivetrain, and bags to use for specific races.
required_facts.source_evidence: 1) bAIpacking Agent by Eduardo Gonzalo Almorox Edu’s [bAIpacking Agent] helps long‑distance cyclists decide which tires, drivetrain, and bags to use for specific races.

required_facts.claim: The agent scrapes event reports from [DotWatcher] (a platform for bike races), stores them in PostgreSQL, and builds a RAG pipeline.
required_facts.source_evidence: The agent scrapes event reports from [DotWatcher] (a platform for bike races), stores them in PostgreSQL, and builds a RAG pipeline.

required_facts.claim: On the backend side, FastAPI resolves the event name, finds similar events, retrieves rider setups, and summarizes evidence.
required_facts.source_evidence: On the backend side, FastAPI resolves the event name, finds similar events, retrieves rider setups, and summarizes evidence.

required_facts.claim: Then the results are presented via a Reflex UI.
required_facts.source_evidence: Then the results are presented via a Reflex UI.

required_facts.claim: Evaluation runs offline: each recommendation call is logged and later scored by a judge script.
required_facts.source_evidence: Evaluation runs offline: each recommendation call is logged and later scored by a judge script.
